rubric.evidence: Verified directly against live Web Speech API ED §4.1.8, merged WebAudio/web-speech-api#192 (2026-10-21), Chromium trunk speech_recognition_result.idl/.cc, speech_recognition.cc, speech_recognition_event.cc, CL 8797156, CL 8836060, runtime_enabled_features.json5, BCD api/SpeechRecognitionResult.json, webstatus.dev, and ChromeStatus 5811907077472256 on 2026-11-27.

reference-contract.json inventories speechStartTime, speechEndTime, and SpeechRecognitionEvent.timeStamp rebasing across all 9 dimensions and explicitly lists pre-existing length, item, and isFinal in outOfScope with sourced rationales.

Complete semantic JS <pre><code> example demonstrating safe feature detection on a live result, 0.0 fallback handling, VTTCue generation, and performance.now() - event.timeStamp delivery lag tracking; links verified HTTP-200 author demos. No v159 CPS demo exists yet.

Every visible source and citation label carries a direct <a href> with target='_blank' rel='noopener'; spec, PR #192, CLs, BCD, webstatus, standards-position, and author demo links verified on 2026-11-27; historical v153 CPS link marked data-demo-rel='related'.
